The '''1997–98 Czech First League''', known as the [[Gambrinus (beer)|Gambrinus]] liga for sponsorship reasons, was the fifth season of top-tier [[association football|football]] in the [[Czech Republic]].

==League changes==

'''Relegated to the [[1997–98 Czech 2. Liga]]'''
* [[Bohemians 1905|Bohemians Prague]] ([[1996–97 Czech First League|16th]])
* [[MFK Karviná|Karviná]] ([[1996–97 Czech First League|15th]])

'''Promoted from the [[1996–97 Czech 2. Liga]]'''
* [[1. FK Příbram|Dukla]] ([[1996–97 Czech 2. Liga|1st]])
* [[AFK Atlantic Lázně Bohdaneč|Lázně Bohdaneč]] ([[1996–97 Czech 2. Liga|2nd]])
